## 2. Key Verified Projects
- [Trujillo AI — Serverless AI Studio & Discord Bot](https://ai.trujillomingorance.com/): Full-stack serverless AI studio and high-speed Discord bot on Cloudflare Workers Edge. Features Meta Llama 3.3 70B streaming, live web search, Flux AI image synthesis, persistent KV memory, and JWT/OTP authentication.
- [FocusGuard — Zero-Trust DNS Shield](https://focusguard.trujillomingorance.com/): Real-time DNS content filtering and malware blocking solution built on Cloudflare Workers serverless edge and D1 database.
- [Solana Forensics — Blockchain Intelligence](https://solanaforensic.com/): Forensic transaction tracking, anomaly detection, and smart contract audit platform on the Solana blockchain network.
- [SysAdmin Automation Suite](https://github.com/AlbertoTrujillo-ITB2425/scripts-1ASIXc): Production Bash, PowerShell, and Python automation suite for Active Directory provisioning, incremental backups, and server monitoring.
